# rule target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ruleTarget`](gmeow-ruleTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ruleTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The asset a rule regulates ([odrl:target](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/target)). Optional; absent when the rule inherits its target from the enclosing rights statement's [`gmeow:statementAbout`](gmeow-statementAbout.md).
